subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Fake Profiles and Catfishing
description: A 60-second lesson on Fake Profiles and Catfishing.

hook.text: A stranger sends a friend request. Attractive photo, mutual friends, interesting bio. All fake.

buildup.text: Scammers create fake profiles using stolen photos to build trust before launching their scheme.

discovery.text: AI-generated profile photos now pass human detection. You can't tell real from fake anymore.

twist.text: Some fake profiles exist for months, building a realistic history before they ever contact a target.

climax.text: An estimated 10% of all social media profiles are fake — and the number is growing.

punchline.text: The profile is perfect because no real person is behind it.

quiz.question: What percentage of social media profiles are estimated to be fake?
